experiment_lock.tested_variable: Single-offer paid-demand baseline at AED 51,900; no comparative creative variable

bounded_variables.allowed_range: Must begin no later than 9 seconds and remain readable for at least 4 seconds
Final 4-6 seconds; one WhatsApp action only

free_variables: Exact source clip selections from the existing Yaris media
Text layout within Instagram safe zones
Use of original presenter audio versus clean voice-over from the approved copy
forbidden_deviations: Hide or soften known repairs into 'minor' or 'accident-free'
Claim warranty, original paint, exact trim, financing or perfect condition

content_objective.audience_signal: UAE buyer actively comparing recent economical GCC sedans around AED 50,000
content_objective.promise_or_problem: A 2026 GCC Yaris with 4,546 km at AED 51,900, presented with transparent known repair information
content_objective.desired_viewer_action: Start an attributed WhatsApp conversation about this exact Yaris and request a viewing

hook_specification.first_frame_job: Show the exact white Yaris and AED 51,900 together so the offer is understood without audio
hook_specification.first_1s_event: Immediate price reveal over a clear front three-quarter view
hook_specification.viewer_question_or_tension: Why is a 2026 low-mileage GCC Yaris priced below many advertised alternatives?
hook_specification.payoff_requirement: Answer with mileage and transparent repair facts before asking for WhatsApp contact

structural_timeline.job: Stop relevant buyers and identify the offer
visual_requirement: Car fills most of vertical frame

visual_requirement: Dashboard/odometer plus exterior or interior detail
proof_requirement: Odometer image or footage must visibly support 4,546 km

visual_requirement: Front, open-hood or relevant existing footage without concealing the area

structural_timeline.job: Let the buyer inspect the visible product briefly

proof_architecture.must_be_visible_or_stated: Used original headlight; original bumper replacement; hood repaired and repainted
proof_architecture.source_or_verification: Business Yaris Reel reviewed with audio
